text:
maria.garcia: heads-up — after yesterday's key rotation one of our customers reported that chat tokens started failing for embeddings routes. full error: 403 PermissionDenied (scope mismatch).

jonathan.lee: do you have request logs or an example token id?

maria.garcia: paste of minimal log:

maria.garcia: ```
[2025-11-05T18:12:03Z] authz: token=tok_abc123 allowlist=[chat.*] route=/v1/embeddings model=text-embed-001 result=DENY reason=scope_mismatch
```

alice_ruiz: suspicious — token claims chat-only, but our per-route enforcement should have rejected earlier. any recent RBAC rule churn?

samir: we rolled out the "permission-surface" refactor last week that collapsed per-model vs per-route tags. possible migration gap.

devsec-bot: FYI: creating incident-XXXX for scope-enforcement regression, assigning to eng-security and eng-runtime.

jonathan.lee: @ops-oncall can you check KMS re-wrap logs around rotation? maybe metadata tags got dropped.

ops-oncall: saw rewrap at 2025-11-05T18:00Z for key=key-prod-1, some metadata warnings: 'missing:key_tags' in 12/120 keys — collecting traces now.

kms-bot: rotation completed for key-prod-1; note: legacy-wrapping path still writes 'key_tag' under 'meta.tag' field.

alice_ruiz: that matches — our authz lookup expects tag under 'tags' (plural). migration likely missed rename.

maria.garcia: proposed mitigation: fallback policy to check alternative metadata fields during token validation, and emergency rollback of migration if needed.

samir: quick patch: authz fallback checker to consult meta.tag || tags || legacy_tag for 24 hours.

jonathan.lee: please also add audit log entries with raw KMS metadata snapshot for affected tokens — we need provenance for compliance.

ops-oncall: capturing snapshots now, pushing to secure-audit bucket with restricted ACLs.

alice_ruiz: after patch, run smoke tests: create token with chat-only scope and attempt embeddings call; expect 403.

maria.garcia: test run results:

maria.garcia: ```
> curl -H "Authorization: Bearer tok_test_chatonly" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"x"}'
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"permission_denied","reason":"scope_mismatch"}
```

samir: ok patch deployed to canary. rolling to prod in 30m if no regressions.

devsec-bot: reminder: create backfill job to re-tag leftover keys with canonical 'tags' field; add retention 90 days.

jonathan.lee: note for postmortem: include timeline of RBAC refactor, KMS field rename, rotation event, and the short-term fallback. assign owners.

maria.garcia: thanks — will open postmortem and link incident-XXXX. :white_check_mark:
